# Green Training USA

> > Green Training USA provides online certification training for RESNET HERS Raters and BPI Building Analysts in the energy efficiency and home performance industry.

Green Training USA is a leading online training provider specializing in energy auditor certifications including RESNET HERS Rater, BPI Building Analyst Professional (BA-P), and BPI Building Analyst Technician (BA-T) programs. The organization offers comprehensive courses in building science principles, weatherization, and home energy performance for professionals seeking careers in energy efficiency.

## Key Topics

- RESNET HERS Rater Certification
- BPI Building Analyst Professional (BA-P)
- BPI Building Analyst Technician (BA-T)
- Building Performance Institute (BPI)
- Energy Auditor Training
- Building Science Principles (BSP)
- Home Performance
- Weatherization
- Energy Efficiency Careers
- Home Energy Professional
- RESNET Training
- BPI Certification Programs
- Energy Auditor Career Paths
- Building Analyst Training
